note: Read by the iOS app (USGSContribution.remoteConfig). enabled: the USGS Did You Feel It? contribution is offered after a shaking report; submit: false opens the event's USGS form inside the app, prefilled from the report, for the user to check and submit (the app never submits it); true allows the app to submit it in the background (the signed config's usgs_submit must allow it too). Keep submit false until the consent text names the precise location that goes to USGS.
